summary: Remote-controlled shell and file/exec operations over WebSocket in @yeaft/webchat-agent
details: The package runs a long-lived agent that connects to a configurable WebSocket server (SERVER_URL) and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers with full host control. On `terminal_create` it spawns a local PTY running bash/pwsh/cmd; on `terminal_input` it forwards `msg.data` from network frames directly into `pty.write()`, giving any party controlling the WS endpoint arbitrary command execution on the installer's host. The message router additionally handles `read_file`, `write_file`, `delete_files`, `git_push`, `execute` (runs a Claude Code conversation with a Bash tool), `restart_agent`, and `upgrade_agent` (server-triggered `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest`) messages, all without additional consent. The default endpoint is `ws://localhost:3456` but production configuration points the agent at a remote Yeaft-controlled server, so whoever operates that server (or anyone who compromises it) holds full read/write/exec on the machine running the agent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
